story:
Everything good starts with a solid foundation. Wolfpack Construction was started by the descendants of a long line of construction workers and home contractors — people who grew up on job sites learning that you take care of customers through quality workmanship and honest service, not through a sales script. With top-grade materials and expert craftsmanship, we make sure your foundation is as solid as ours. From floor to ceiling, we build spaces that support everything you do and everyone you care about.

Today that means a Florida Certified General Contractor's licence (CGC1531295), an A+ BBB accreditation, recognition as one of the top 20 contractors in the area by The Home Depot, and 4.9 stars across 63 Google reviews — earned on roofing, residential and commercial construction, remodels, and 24/7 emergency remediation across Orlando. Holding the general contractor's licence is deliberate: it is what lets one company carry a project from an emergency board-up all the way through to the final walkthrough without ever handing you off to a stranger.

What has not changed is the pack. We are still family-owned, still at 2302 Mercator Drive in Orlando rather than dispatching crews in from another state, and still small enough that you will know the name of the person running your job. We are results-driven and humbly confident — we listen, we collaborate, we move fast and we follow through. We treat everyone like family, we communicate clearly and honestly, and we speak Spanish. Free estimates, financing options, and one quality at one price, every time.
